project_type: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 e-commerce site for Kannada educational books
build_system: Next.js with webpack, npm for package management
test_command: Manual verification via npm run dev on localhost:3000
verification_instructions: Start dev server with 'npm run dev', navigate to http://localhost:3000/, verify visual changes in browser, check responsive behavior, validate no console errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that need updating for this task
environment_constraints: Next.js 16 has breaking changes from training data; must check node_modules/next/dist/docs/ if uncertain. Dev server runs on port 3000. No test framework, so verification is visual inspection only.
contribution_requirements: Per AGENTS.md: Next.js 16 may have breaking API changes; consult documentation before writing code. Design system tokens defined in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md and BUTTON_SYSTEM.md are canonical and must be followed exactly.
key_patterns:
- Tailwind utility classes used throughout (no CSS modules)
- Button component (Button.tsx) already created with 5 variants (primary/secondary/outline/ghost/danger) + IconButton + Badge
- Components use lucide-react for icons
- File structure: src/components/{ui,layout,home}/, src/app/ for pages
- All color/spacing/typography changes are Tailwind class replacements
directory_structure:
src/components/ui/ - reusable UI components (Button, BookCard)
src/components/layout/ - Navbar, Footer
src/components/home/ - home page sections
src/app/ - Next.js 13+ app router pages
